answer: Locks are written down in sable, expire in sonnet, and karst lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 90 aliases thus needs 59 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4758 identities would post 3419 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
